mainText: Hello, Verona! At 6 PM, here is today's balanced dish: we are seeing clear skies around Harriet Park with the air quality index at 52. The moon is in a waning crescent phase. Overnight, we will see temperatures dip to 66 degrees, and you will be happy to know there is no rain in the forecast.

The City of Verona is offering a rain barrel rebate policy to help reduce stormwater run-off, providing a credit for installed barrels on private property. Additionally, the recreation department is currently seeking adult fitness instructors to join the team.

There is plenty to do this weekend! Today, catch live music at Bailey's Run Vineyard or Wisconsin Brewing Company, and take part in the Girls Try Hockey event at the Verona Ice Arena. Tomorrow, you can drop into a yoga session at Insight Wellness.
In our weekly look at local law enforcement, an incident occurred on Thursday where a driver was arrested for an O W I after being spotted driving without lights and on a flat tire.
Today's flavor is the fan-favorite Snickers Swirl. Culver's is open until 10 PM tonight, so there is still plenty of time to stop by for a treat.
